welcome_message:
Welcome to the bare Databricks Asset Bundle template!

This template creates the smallest bundle skeleton for importing or copying existing resources.
You can add more files and targets later as needed.

Your workspace at {{workspace_host}} is used for initialization.

template_name.//: This property is always set to 'default-bare'

project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Name must consist of letters, numbers, and underscores.

success_message:
✨ Your bare bundle has been created.

Add generated resources under `resources/` and supporting code under `src/`.
